scenario: fault-version panel phone first one-touch call after reboot/version switch

why: The physical panel target is fixed to 8000 for this fault-version scenario.
The real AIM/FXS transcript contains only three DTMF events and all three are digit 0.
The first expected digit 8 is absent before SIP-level interpretation is needed.
The capture plane was armed, durable and reported zero kernel drops, with PCM RX/TX present, so the missing 8 cannot be attributed to a known PCAP capture drop.

localization_boundary.proven: The loss occurs no later than AIM/FXS DTMF event ingestion; it is upstream of SIP call-number construction.
localization_boundary.not_proven: This evidence alone does not distinguish panel event generation, SLIC/driver, libhardware, and AIM as the exact first failing component.
localization_boundary.required_for_deeper_root_cause: A lower-layer raw event/debug source earlier than the current AIM/FXS event stream, correlated by source time against the same first-call scenario.

coverage_anomaly.root_cause: PcapCoverageEvidenceBuilder allowed historical epochs/non-durable segments outside the current required CoverageWindow to contaminate the uncertain boundary decision for a long-lived CaptureSession.
coverage_anomaly.fix: Scope epoch/gap/non-durable-segment uncertainty to objects which overlap the current required CoverageWindow; normalize datetime timezone semantics for SQLite/PostgreSQL parity.
coverage_anomaly.release_effect: Does not invalidate the abnormal first-digit-loss finding.
